text:
Asha Patel: Quick preflight for the micro-lab next Tue — short checklist. Reg page live & copy locked? Zoom config (cloud recording + SRT), recording fallback, HubSpot lead routing, and post-event clip owner. Who can own which?
Ben Ortiz: I can lock the reg copy + add UTMs. Will push a PR to the staging page with final CTA. ETA today by 3pm.
Carmen Li: HubSpot mapping is nearly done. Need to confirm hidden fields: benchmark_group, utm_campaign, referrer. Also confirm which lifecycle stage we set on import (attendee vs lead).
Diego R.: Zoom settings recs: host = Asha, co-host = Ben, cloud recording ON (record active speaker + gallery), enable SRT captions. Waiting room: keep on until -5min then disable for greenroom. Add alternative RTMP fallback in case cloud record fails.
Asha Patel: RTMP fallback details? Carmen, will HubSpot accept a CSV of registrants + benchmark tag? Also need clip naming scheme for S3 (so editors can find files).
Carmen Li: Yes, HubSpot import accepts CSV with "benchmark_group" header. Lifetime stage on import = "lead" then we run enrichment to convert to "opportunity" later. For naming: use: event_micro-lab_{{date}}_{{speaker}}_{{clip_type}}. Example: event_micro-lab_2026-04-06_Jane_intro.mp4
Ben Ortiz: Reg page CTA will include UTM campaign = micro-lab-apr2026. I'll add hidden input for benchmark_group and ensure GA firing. Also adding a small thank-you message and link to calendar invite in the success page.
Diego R.: RTMP fallback snippet for Ops if recording fails:
```
# if zoom recording status == failed -> rtmp fallback
rtmp://fallback.example.com/live/event_micro-lab_2026
# ensure S3 ingestion job watches prefix: /events/micro-lab/2026-04-06/
```
Asha Patel: Perfect. One more: post-event workflow — clips + transcript in 48h, short highlight reel in 5 days, full edit in 10. Who owns clips? @Ben for drafts, @Carmen for lead enrichment after import.
Ben Ortiz: I’ll own draft clips & highlight edits (48h draft). Will tag Carmen in the clip sheet once uploaded to S3. :white_check_mark:
Carmen Li: I’ll take lead enrichment and set lifecycle stages in HubSpot, plus assign SDR owners. Will export CSV and run import job within 24h of clip upload.
webinar-bot: Reminder: Scheduled meeting 'ScaleBench micro-lab' will start 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. Cloud recording enabled.
Asha Patel: Thanks team — final items: Ben please confirm S3 path when uploaded, Diego confirm RTMP route test tomorrow at 10am PT. If either fails ping me.
Diego R.: RTMP test scheduled 10am PT tomorrow, pinging infra.
Ben Ortiz: S3 path will be s3://redwood-events/micro-lab/2026-04-06/. Will confirm after test upload.
Asha Patel: Great — closing thread, will post the final runbook in Notion and tag owners. :rocket:
